up: Retrieve all activity rows for the parent compound CHEMBL1173655 and all of its salts that have an IC50 measurement in nM against target CHEMBL203 (Epidermal growth factor receptor). Identify the parent and its salts using the molecule_hierarchy table. Return the following columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
sql:
WITH compound_set AS (
  SELECT parent.molregno, parent.chembl_id
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1173655'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT child.molregno, child.chembl_id
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1173655'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  cs.molregno AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM compound_set cset
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cset.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN activities act ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN assays a ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id
JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = a.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM';
